Method: Rec.709 display RGB luma. Absolute residual from 3x3 median. Pooled mean and nearest-rank p95. Fixed-pixel temporal change on consecutive region intersections. Shared FXAA shadow attenuation boundary (>0.03 against matched no-shadow). Character band: upper 18..68% of silhouette, eroded 3 px, Manhattan band distance. Control: body beyond twice band radius from any body shadow boundary, central luma gradient <0.02. Ground band and ground control: every world pixel more than band radius + 3 px from the visible body, within and beyond twice the band radius of a world shadow boundary, texture kept. Silhouette intersects no-shadow player-minus-world difference (>4/255 in any RGB channel), excluding occluded character pixels. Self-shadow edges can enter the character band, and the player's own cast shadow can enter the ground band. Review the edge crops visually.
